answer: In 2025 women represented 37% of all new hires, 32% of frontline managers and 32% of senior leadership. Schneider Electric set a 2026–2030 ambition of 40% women in leadership positions. New hires means all 2025 new hires; frontline management means junior and mid-level managers whose direct reports are individual contributors only; leadership means vice-presidents and above, excluding direct reports to the CEO. The ambition is global but does not apply where such ambitions are prohibited.

normalized_value.frontline_boundary: junior and mid-level management whose direct reports are individual contributors only
normalized_value.leadership_boundary: VPs and above, excluding direct reports to the CEO
normalized_value.geographic_qualification: global ambition except territories that prohibit such ambition
